scripts.dev: concurrently --names "node,client,fastapi,celery" --prefix-colors "cyan,green,yellow,magenta" "npm run dev --prefix server" "npm run dev --prefix client" "uvicorn server.app.main:app --port 8000 --reload" "celery -A server.app.worker.celery_app worker --loglevel=warning"
scripts.dev:node: concurrently "npm run dev --prefix server" "npm run dev --prefix client"
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix client && npm run build --prefix server
scripts.install:all: npm install && npm install --prefix server && npm install --prefix client
